# 1) bar length over history
def barlen(fr):
    return len(fr.ascii.split('\n')[-1].replace('G','').replace('\n',''))
print("bar lengths per history frame:")
for i,h in enumerate(history):
    print(i, h.frame.step, barlen(h.frame))
# 2) ball start
print("ball in first frame:")
for n in history[0].frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='N':
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        print("  start N at r",min(rows),max(rows),"c",min(cols),max(cols))
# 3) mouse probes
def ball_pos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
def ndiff():
    bl=previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); al=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ch=[(r,c,bl[r][c],al[r][c]) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if bl[r][c]!=al[r][c]]
    return ch
print("ball now:", ball_pos())
for (r,c,tag) in [(19,48,'REDpodium'),(36,48,'BLUEpodium'),(25,5,'empty'),(42,8,'ball')]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    ch=ndiff()
    print(f"MOUSE {tag} ({r},{c}): changed={len(ch)} cells; ball={ball_pos()}")
    if ch[:6]: print("   sample",ch[:6])
